newsitem.title: UK: AEA buys British Rail research unit.
newsitem.headline: AEA buys British Rail research unit.

text.p: Newly-floated specialist science and engineering group AEA Technology Plc said on Friday it had bought BR Research Limited from the state-owned British Railways Board (BR) for 10.8 million stg cash.

The deal, one of the final parts of the privatisation of BR, will enable AEA "to become a leading supplier of science and engineering services to the transport industry", the company said in a statement.
BR Research provides consultancy, research and development and engineering testing and services to customers in the rail industry in Britain and abroad.
In the year to end-March 1996 the unit, which employs about 260 people, had sales of 17.8 million stg and profits before interest of 1.4 million stg.

AEA Technology's chief executive, Peter Watson, who said the buy would capitalise on BR Research's worldwide reputation for technical excellence, was previously the BR board member for engineering, and his responsibilities included BR Research.
